_comment: Expected cues of the self-authored caption files in this folder (start_ms, end_ms, text), as vv_ytdlp::captions::parse_vtt returns them. The files imitate what yt-dlp writes for YouTube (manual Turkish track with '>>' speaker marks, rolling English automatic track) plus hand-written edge cases. Written by us, no real video's text (the repo is public). Used by vv-ytdlp captions_fixture.rs, the fake yt-dlp and real_ytdlp.rs.
